principle: Canonical issue census defines existence. Semantic retrieval enriches known records but may never define whether a reviewed title exists.

gates: metadata expected review count equals census count for every completed deep-canon issue
every canonical review title resolves inside its own issue
every issue-local game alias resolves to the same canonical entity
raw review-context coverage is measured separately and does not turn a valid scorecard into a missing review
